defaultDescription.zh-CN: 坐落于怀俄明州提顿村（Teton Village）雪道正脚下，走出Ski Concierge露台约30米即抵主缆车与百人大缆车，兼具恒温室外泳池与大提顿国家公园冬季生态向导服务。
defaultDescription.en: Anchored slopeside in Teton Village just 30 m from Jackson Hole's base lifts and Aerial Tram, pairing full Ski Concierge service with outdoor heated pools and winter Grand Teton wildlife safaris.
defaultDescription.zh-Hant: 坐落於懷俄明州提頓村（Teton Village）雪道正腳下，走出Ski Concierge露臺約30米即抵主纜車與百人大纜車，兼具恆溫室外泳池與大提頓國家公園冬季生態嚮導服務。
